summary: Phase 149O.12C -- HATP Signing CLI Integration + Full HSCE Attack-Matrix Implementation: bounded production implementation phase (Wave E + Wave F of the 149O.11 plan). Ran the full required initial inspection (git status/branch/log/rev-list, pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect, telegram notify status, phase-report show --latest and reconcile --phase-id 149O.12B) and confirmed the expected baseline: repo clean, 149O.12B completed/complete/pushed, HSCE-001 v1.1 unchanged, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read the full HSCE-001 v1.1 contract (all 79 requirements, both v1.0 sections and the v1.1 repair), the 149O.11 implementation plan's CLI section (section 13), the 149O.12A/149O.12B phase reports, and the production source (hatp_signing_ceremony.py, hatp_evidence_store.py, hatp_signed_evidence.py, decision_session.py for the exit-code-category convention precedent, commands/agent.py's run_rollback for the CLI-handler pattern precedent, cli.py's cltr/decision-session multi-level subparser registration precedent) to reuse exact existing conventions rather than inventing new ones. Implemented exactly two production changes: src/pcae/commands/hatp.py (NEW) -- run_hatp_sign_rollback(args) -> int, the sole handler, calling only production_sign_rollback_evidence with exactly root/site/job_id/per_id (zero overrides, F-2 non-regression), cross-field locator validation (site-conditional required/forbidden --job-id/--per-id, rejected before any production call, exit code 2, distinct from the closed HSCE error_type vocabulary per governing-prompt guidance), a centralized error_type-to-exit-code mapping covering the closed 12-member vocabulary (10 members carried directly on hatp_signing_ceremony.py's own exception classes, evidence_conflict/evidence_persistence_failure mapped explicitly from hatp_evidence_store.py's exceptions, evidence_serialization_failure additionally covering hatp_signed_evidence.py's own structural HATPSignedEvidenceError), and human/JSON output rendering with no approved/allowed/permission/executed-resembling field anywhere in either schema; and src/pcae/cli.py (MODIFY, registration-only, a pure addition confirmed via git diff --numstat showing zero lines removed) -- a new pcae hatp -> pcae hatp sign -> pcae hatp sign rollback three-level subparser hierarchy mirroring the existing cltr -> cltr shadow -> status precedent, with --site {ag3,ag5} (argparse choices), --job-id/--per-id (both optional at the parser level, cross-validated in the handler per the plan's own documented reason argparse's own mutual-exclusion groups cannot express the site-conditional requirement), and --json. Wrote 103 new tests across two files (78 in tests/test_hatp_cli.py -- exact grammar, cross-field locator validation with a zero-production-call spy, the full 31-flag forbidden-flag inventory (union of the governing prompt's and the 149O.11 plan's own lists) confirmed both by argparse runtime rejection and by a tokenize-based static source scan that excludes docstring/comment tokens, zero-override production-path proof via inspect.signature and an AST walk of the one call site, help-without-hardware in a genuine subprocess at all three command levels with no .pcae/hatp-evidence/ side effect, error-vocabulary/exit-code mapping completeness (set-equality against the closed 12-member vocabulary, full 9-category exit coverage), every one of the 12 error types' human and JSON output and exit code, human/JSON success-output schema exactness with no authority-claiming field, evidence-conflict never prompting an interactive overwrite, and an unexpected-internal-exception-is-never-mislabeled-as-success guarantee; 25 in tests/test_phase_149o_12c_hsce_attack_matrix.py -- all 21 mandatory HSCE attacks plus the 4 extra 149O.10.2-Obs-3/temp-FD-mutation/many-writer-race/non-EEXIST-link-error implementation attacks, each entering through the highest practical assembled boundary: CLI-argument-shaped attacks (11) through the real parser, ceremony-flow attacks (16-21) through the real, assembled CLI handler bridged to the real, injectable hatp_signing_ceremony.sign_rollback_evidence with only the hardware provider/trust store/clock faked (never sign_rollback_evidence itself monkeypatched inside production code -- only the single production_sign_rollback_evidence symbol imported into commands/hatp.py, per the governing prompt's own first safe test-seam option), envelope/store-shaped attacks (1-2, 5-10, 13-15) -- which have no CLI-argument surface at all -- against a genuine envelope produced by a real, CLI-driven signing call rather than a synthetic ad hoc one, idempotent/conflicting-rewrite attacks (3-4) and the wrong-operation-replay attack (12) driven twice end to end through the CLI handler, and the four extra store-concurrency/fault-injection attacks seeded with real resolved signing context). Registered both new test modules in tests/conftest.py::FAST_GREEN_MODULES (deterministic, real-filesystem-only I/O, no hardware, identical profile to 149O.12A/149O.12B's own already-registered modules). Applied the established 149O.5-F-3 lesson to six pre-existing phase-boundary test files whose stale 'no HATP CLI exists yet' snapshots were always going to become false the moment this phase's own, previously-recommended work landed: tests/test_phase_149o_12b_..._implementation.py and tests/test_phase_149o_12a_..._implementation.py (production-file allowlists widened to include this phase's two files; the 'CLI must not exist yet' assertions inverted to 'CLI now exists, exactly as recommended'; every other invariant -- earlier-phase byte-identity, contract byte-identity, no-PB-import, no-AG-authority-wiring -- left completely unchanged), and tests/test_phase_149o_8_...py / tests/test_phase_149o_9_...py (two naive whole-text '--provider' substring scans, which this module's own thorough docstring explaining why no such flag exists tripped as a false positive, narrowed to a real add_argument("--provider"...) regex detection that correctly finds nothing; 149O.9's own 'no CLI implemented yet' check scoped explicitly to exclude commands/hatp.py by name so 149O.9's own historical claim about its own files remains intact). Ran and reconfirmed non-regression: tests/test_hatp_signed_evidence.py, tests/test_hatp_evidence_store.py, tests/test_hatp_signing_ceremony.py, tests/test_phase_149o_12b_..._implementation.py, tests/test_phase_149o_12a_..._implementation.py (321 passed together, 0 failed); a full -k "hatp or rollback_approval" sweep showing exactly 13 pre-existing, unrelated failures identical before and after this phase's changes (independently confirmed via a git-stash-based clean-baseline A/B comparison, down from a raw 15-failure baseline count since two of those 15 were themselves the 149O.12A/149O.12B files' own stale-CLI-snapshot false positives this phase's own 149O.5-F-3 widening fixed); a focused -k "rollback or permission_broker" sweep plus tests/test_agent.py -k rollback (1403+78 passed, the same 5 pre-existing unrelated failures, 0 new) confirming no rollback dispatch behavior changed; the report-trust suite (test_phase_report_trust_gate*.py, test_phase_reports*.py, test_push_phase_report_identity_137f1.py -- 272 passed, 0 failed); and Fast Green (4868 passed, 2 skipped, 1 pre-existing unrelated collection error for the fido2-requiring 149O.7 module, 0 genuine failures -- one flaky -n-auto-only unrelated test passing standalone -- an exact +40 delta over the 149O.12B-entering baseline of 4828, matching this phase's own newly Fast-Green-registered test_hatp_cli/test_phase_149o_12c_hsce_attack_matrix modules). The 149O.12B Python-3.9 publication-timestamp defect (pcae.governance.publication.coordinator._parse_timestamp lacking trailing-Z normalization) was reconfirmed still present, still out of this phase's single-CLI-file scope, and worked around only at the test layer via an identical autouse monkeypatch fixture (necessarily duplicated, not imported, into tests/test_phase_149o_12c_hsce_attack_matrix.py, since pytest fixtures are not importable as fixtures across files) -- flagged again as retained, non-blocking debt for a future, separately-scoped governed phase. VERDICT: HATP SIGNING CLI + HSCE ASSEMBLED IMPLEMENTATION: IMPLEMENTED -- READY FOR INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION. This completes the full six-wave 149O.11 decomposition: 149O.12A (Waves A+B, evidence model/store), 149O.12B (Waves C+D, resolver/orchestrator), and 149O.12C (Waves E+F, CLI + integrated attack matrix, this phase). HSCE Signing Ceremony + Evidence Store Implementation is now COMPLETE at the model/store/resolver/orchestrator/CLI level; production rollback consumption, execution enforcement, and HATP production activation are explicitly NOT complete/NOT READY. No AG3/AG5 mandatory consumption wiring was implemented. No rollback dispatch behavior changed. No Permission Broker behavior changed. No hardware was touched outside this phase's own deterministic tests. HSCE-001 v1.1, HATP-001 v1.0, and RAE-001 v1.0 all remain byte-unchanged. 149O.12A's two modules and 149O.12B's one module remain byte-unchanged. B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_12C_HATP_SIGNING_CLI_INTEGRATION_FULL_HSCE_ATTACK_MATRIX_IMPLEMENTATION.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.13, HATP Signing Ceremony + Evidence Store Independent Implementation Verification.
